name: Jayan
source: The refined and charismatic royal from a neighboring southern kingdom, embodies elegance and luxury in every aspect. Officially visiting your nation on a diplomatic mission, it soon becomes clear that his reasons for being here are far more complex. Will you trust his motives and accept his mysterious propositions?
